description_en: Source-aligned specification and provenance; embedded prompts are data, not authority.
description_zh: 对齐来源的规格与出处；内嵌提示作为数据，不授予权限。

sources.name_zh: 02_扇出聚合_工作流可观测性探针
sources.supplied_filename: 02_扇出聚合_工作流可观测性探针.md

execution_nodes.summary_en: Check applicability, typed output and scope; disclose missing inputs.
Freeze obligations, comparison and acceptance rules, sources, budgets and authority.
Dispatch bounded attempts with separately verified session, workspace and tool boundaries.
Validate identity, version, source and obligations; commit eligible artifacts and provisional Q.
Reconcile R minus Q and optional dispositions; preserve all missing obligations.
Normalize only under versioned identity, time, unit and value semantics; preserve originals.
Group duplicate conclusions and verified upstream families; retain cards and unknown lineage.
Distinguish dimensional differences from real conflicts; preserve both sides and authorized adjudication.
Check declared seams as pass/fail/unknown; roll up leaf populations and exceptions.
Emit typed report with structural acceptance separate from seams and business authority.
Repair affected dependencies under limits, recompute Q, version reports and evidence actual handoff.
execution_nodes.name_zh: 补证、局部恢复、交接与封存

probe_nodes.summary_en: Choose audit mode, target and permissions.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 确定观测模式、目标与权限

probe_nodes.summary_en: Adapt inputs and freeze an audit snapshot without inventing populations.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 读取并适配输入，冻结审计快照

probe_nodes.summary_en: Verify identities, versions, producer watermarks and clock trust.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 核对身份、版本、事件水位与时钟

probe_nodes.summary_en: Check required fields, data quality and source evidence.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 检查数据质量与所需字段

probe_nodes.summary_en: Classify gaps, necessity, affected scope and recoverability.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 生成缺口台账并判断能否恢复

probe_nodes.summary_en: Recover existing facts or derive deterministically within authority and cumulative budgets.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 在授权范围内补采或确定性复算

probe_nodes.summary_en: Verify lineage, conflicts and seam records by comparable groups.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 按可比组核验来源、冲突与接缝记录

probe_nodes.summary_en: Calculate supported metrics with exact denominators, provenance and unknown reasons.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 计算指标，保留分子分母和不可计算原因

probe_nodes.summary_en: Propose diagnoses, source-bound patches and bounded actions.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 形成诊断、补丁与限定范围的动作建议

probe_nodes.summary_en: Verify adoption, dependency rechecks and explicit closure receipts.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 接收采纳与重验回执，更新缺口闭环状态

probe_nodes.summary_en: Seal inputs, report, metric versions, unresolved gaps and collection overhead.
probe_nodes.name_zh: 输出、封存报告及自身采集账本

metrics.summary_en: Qualified required logical shards / frozen required shards. Include every required obligation; no plan means not computable.
metrics.formula_zh:
必选分片覆盖率 = |Q| / |R|
缺失分片集合 = R − Q

metrics.summary_en: Verified upstream source families / effective cards in one comparable group. Unknown lineage makes the overall value null; this is not truth probability.
Independent reference conflicts fully preserved in report and evidenced handoff / reference conflicts. No reference or handoff means not computable; empty reference is not applicable.
Changes in coverage, verified source families, cost and wall time under the same frozen task and policies. No comparable baseline means no increment or causal claim; keep other overhead.
metrics.name_zh: 新增执行者的增量收益
metrics.formula_zh:
覆盖增量 = 新配置覆盖率 − 基线覆盖率
来源增量 = 新配置已核验来源族数 − 基线已核验来源族数
费用增量 = 新配置总费用 − 基线总费用
时长变化 = 新配置墙钟时长 − 基线墙钟时长

metrics.summary_en: Correctly disclosed missing required shards / independently reconciled missing required shards. No missing shards is not applicable; no plan is not computable.
metrics.formula_zh: 最终报告中正确列出的缺失必选分片数 ÷ 独立核对得到的实际缺失必选分片数
metrics.boundary_zh: 需要冻结 R、有效 Q 和报告；无缺片时不适用，缺计划时不可计算

metrics.summary_en: Cards meeting required comparison fields / cards under review. Completeness is not truth; incomplete inventory permits subset reporting only.
metrics.formula_zh: 必要对象、时间、单位、分母等字段满足场景契约的卡数 ÷ 当前待验卡数
metrics.boundary_zh: 字段不适用必须有规则；完整不等于内容正确；卡清单不完整时只报子集

metrics.summary_en: Cards with required claim-card-source-version/snapshot chain / cards requiring checks. Reachability does not prove source independence.
metrics.formula_zh: 必须的主张—卡—来源—版本／快照定位均可回溯的卡数 ÷ 应检查卡数
metrics.boundary_zh: 必须来源链清单由场景定义；来源血缘独立性是另一个检查，不因地址可访问就通过

metrics.summary_en: Verified redundant cards / effective cards in one comparable group. Unknown lineage makes overall value null; keep all originals and mappings.
metrics.formula_zh: 同一可比组内，因已核验同源关系被标记为冗余的卡数 ÷ 有效卡数
metrics.boundary_zh: 未核验血缘时整体值为空；保留代表卡与原卡映射，不实际删除原件

metrics.summary_en: Required logical shards finally timed out / frozen required shards. A failed timeout attempt followed by success is not a final shard timeout; online values are provisional.
metrics.formula_zh: 最终以超时收口的必选逻辑分片数 ÷ 冻结必选分片数
metrics.boundary_zh: 需权威终态与截止政策；在线仍运行时标暂定；曾超时后成功不计最终超时

metrics.summary_en: Distinct submitted versions rejected / distinct submitted versions entering admission. Deduplicate deliveries and disclose pending checks or unknown outcomes.
metrics.formula_zh: 在选定快照被明确拒收的唯一提交工件版本数 ÷ 进入准入检查的唯一提交工件版本数
metrics.boundary_zh: 先按工件版本去重；待检查版本另列，终态未知时整体不完整

metrics.summary_en: Report commit time minus that round's N04 start; exclude waiting before aggregation and keep rounds and end-to-end time separate. Untrusted clocks mean not computable.
metrics.formula_zh: 单轮聚合报告提交时刻 − 该轮 N04 聚合开始时刻
metrics.boundary_zh: 不含开始聚合前等待分片的时间；补数多轮分别计时，另报端到端总时长；时钟不可信时不可计算

metrics.summary_en: Required seam rules with known pass/fail / frozen required rules. Show pass/fail/unknown counts; checked failure is not passing; empty applicable set is not applicable.
metrics.formula_zh: 已有确定结果的必需接缝规则数 ÷ 冻结必需规则数，并另列通过、失败、未知数
metrics.boundary_zh: 失败规则属于已检查，但绝不等于通过；无适用规则时不适用并说明

metrics.summary_en: Required shards qualified on first attempt / required shards with first attempt started. Disclose unstarted shards and provisional unfinished first attempts.
metrics.formula_zh: 首次尝试即产出满足局部契约工件的必选分片数 ÷ 已启动首次尝试的必选分片数
metrics.boundary_zh: 在线首次尝试未结束时结果暂定；未启动分片另列，不能隐藏调度缺口

metrics.summary_en: Business attempts / distinct started logical shards. No retries gives one; exclude probe reads; no starts is not applicable.
metrics.formula_zh: 业务执行尝试总数 ÷ 已启动的唯一逻辑分片数
metrics.boundary_zh: 无重试且每片启动一次时为 1；探针读取不计业务尝试；无启动时不适用

metrics.summary_en: Due recoverable gaps with source verification, adoption, recheck and closure evidence / all due recoverable gaps. Count gap IDs; separate future and unrecoverable gaps.
metrics.formula_zh: 已通过来源核验、被采纳、完成重验且关闭的可恢复缺口数 ÷ 已到处理截止点的可恢复缺口数
metrics.boundary_zh: 按缺口标识去重，不按补丁条数；新发现未到期缺口另列；不可恢复业务证据缺口单列

metrics.summary_en: Verified critical instances / authoritative expected instances from a frozen plan, state or producer manifest. Received events cannot define their own denominator.
metrics.formula_zh: 已核验的关键事件实例数 ÷ 应有关键事件实例数
metrics.boundary_zh: 分母来自冻结计划、权威状态或生产者清单，不以已收到事件反推；缺少可信清单时不可计算

metrics.summary_en: Actual reads, wall time, tokens and costs separately. Probe and business accounting share the global cap; unknown costs stay null; no baseline means no causal business-delay claim.
metrics.formula_zh: 探针实际读取次数、墙钟时长、令牌、费用分别报告
metrics.boundary_zh: 与业务分账且共享总授权上限；费用未知不填零；无对照不声称探针增加了多少业务延迟

execution_cases.summary_en: Keep three boundary dimensions and shared-workspace risk; do not vote.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 三种不同边界分别为隔离、共享、受限
execution_cases.expected_zh: 不进行二对一投票；保留三维限定和共享风险

execution_cases.summary_en: Two of three required shards means 2/3 coverage and accepted false, with missing obligations.
execution_cases.expected_zh: 覆盖 2/3，缺片与缺维度进入报告，`accepted` 为假

execution_cases.summary_en: Three same-source comparable cards form only one verified family.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 同一命题三张卡引用同一上游来源
execution_cases.expected_zh: 工件可齐全，但只能形成一个已核验来源族

execution_cases.summary_en: Retain both mutually exclusive claims and sources; unresolved necessary conflict blocks admission.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 同一可比键下两个互斥值
execution_cases.expected_zh: 原始双方、冲突标识和来源保留；未裁决时不准入

execution_cases.summary_en: No unit/currency sum without supported conversion.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 金额的单位或币种不同
execution_cases.expected_zh: 无明确换算依据时不加总，不凭数值相似直接归一

execution_cases.summary_en: Retries/messages cannot enlarge shard denominators or repeat effective artifacts/actions.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 分片重试或消息重复投递
execution_cases.expected_zh: 分片分母不变；重复消息不新增有效工件或重复业务动作

execution_cases.summary_en: Permanent failure remains in the plan and partial success stays partial.
execution_cases.expected_zh: 不删除预期分片，不把其余成功片包装成全量完成

execution_cases.summary_en: Keep local qualification separate from failed total seam; block normal business admission.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 所有局部金额合格但合计越界
execution_cases.expected_zh: 结构准入与接缝失败分别记录，正常业务裁决通道不放行

execution_cases.summary_en: Reject verdict, authority and threshold patches and audit without mutation.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 探针补丁试图改业务结论、权限或验收阈值
execution_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝并审计，原始状态不变

execution_cases.summary_en: Reject or reevaluate a stale source-version patch against the exact base.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 来源版本补丁基准摘要过期
execution_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝或重新评估，不能套用到新工件

execution_cases.summary_en: Without a probe, mandatory local checks remain; optional observation can degrade.
execution_cases.expected_zh: 本地强制检查照常；关键数据缺失时不充分，非关键观测可降级

execution_cases.summary_en: Quarantine late old-plan/timeout results; never overwrite a sealed report.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 旧计划结果或超时结果迟到
execution_cases.expected_zh: 原计划留痕，当前已封存报告不被覆盖

execution_cases.summary_en: No historical backfill from current content without historical snapshots.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 只有当前来源，无历史快照
execution_cases.expected_zh: 不补造历史内容及历史发生时间

execution_cases.summary_en: Expose missing leaves through hierarchical gather.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 分层聚合中某组漏一个叶子
execution_cases.expected_zh: 上层仍能定位叶子缺席，不能只看到组级成功

execution_cases.summary_en: Replay frozen inputs after model/rule changes and locate version-caused differences.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 规则版本变化或模型替换
execution_cases.expected_zh: 用同一冻结输入回归；差异能定位到版本与规则

execution_cases.summary_en: Label fixtures and reject their use as real production evidence.
execution_cases.condition_zh: 固定样例被送入生产报告
execution_cases.expected_zh: 明确标注并按来源政策拒绝其冒充真实证据

probe_cases.summary_en: Two of three qualified shards gives 2/3 coverage and a missing shard.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 已知三片，两片合格
probe_cases.expected_zh: M01 为 2/3；缺席清单能定位第三片

probe_cases.summary_en: No plan means no coverage denominator even with successful results.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 只有成功结果，没有计划
probe_cases.expected_zh: 覆盖不可计算；不把结果数量当作计划全集

probe_cases.summary_en: Deduplicate shard coverage and messages; count actual attempts for retries.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 同一分片重试并重复投递事件
probe_cases.expected_zh: 覆盖不重复计数；重试放大率使用尝试数

probe_cases.summary_en: Three same-source cards give independence 1/3 and redundancy 2/3; keep originals.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 同命题三卡同一上游来源
probe_cases.expected_zh: M02 为 1/3，M08 为 2/3，原始卡仍在

probe_cases.summary_en: Different URLs with unknown lineage give overall null independence.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 三卡不同网址但血缘未核验
probe_cases.expected_zh: M02 整体为空，列出未知来源，不自动计为三份独立证据

probe_cases.summary_en: Different isolation dimensions are neither votes nor comparable conflicts.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 会话隔离、工作区共享、工具受限
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不误标为同维度冲突，不做多数表决

probe_cases.summary_en: One of two reference conflicts fully delivered gives 1/2 retention; locate the lost conflict.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 两个参考冲突只完整交接一个
probe_cases.expected_zh: M03 为 1/2，并能定位丢失的冲突

probe_cases.summary_en: Empty reference, missing reliable reference and missing handoff get appropriate null states.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 无参考冲突、无可靠参考集或无交接记录
probe_cases.expected_zh: 分别标不适用或不可计算；不伪造百分之百

probe_cases.summary_en: Untrusted cross-machine clocks cannot provide definite corrected latency.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 事件时间来自不可信跨机时钟
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不输出未经校正的确定时延，记录时钟限制

probe_cases.summary_en: Reject current-page historical backfill and record the unrecoverable/snapshot gap.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 读取当前网页尝试补历史版本
probe_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝历史倒填，生成不可恢复或需历史快照的缺口

probe_cases.summary_en: Sent patches without adoption and recheck receipts are not closed.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 补丁已发送但没有采纳或重验回执
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不计补数闭环，不声称业务状态已改善

probe_cases.summary_en: Reject and audit changes to accepted or raw claims.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 补丁试图改 `accepted` 或原始主张
probe_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝并留下审计记录

probe_cases.summary_en: Reject or reevaluate a superseded-base patch.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 旧版本补丁到达已修订工件
probe_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝或重新评估，不能无条件套用

probe_cases.summary_en: Audit independently without an execution receiver or new business run.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 没有执行流程接收端
probe_cases.expected_zh: 独立生成报告与建议，仍可完成审计，不触发业务运行

probe_cases.summary_en: Stop active reads on budget or authority limits; report partial evidence.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 探针预算耗尽或来源无权限
probe_cases.expected_zh: 停止主动采集，输出部分结果与明确限制

probe_cases.summary_en: No comparable baseline means no causal gains, only evidenced contribution.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 新增执行者但没有可比基线
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不输出因果收益；仅可报告可核验贡献

probe_cases.summary_en: Nine qualified leaves and one failed leaf gives 9/10, not group average.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 一组九片合格、一组一片失败
probe_cases.expected_zh: 叶子覆盖为 9/10，不把两组平均为 1/2

probe_cases.summary_en: No shard semantics means dedicated metrics not applicable; keep general probes.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 单执行者链式流程没有分片语义
probe_cases.expected_zh: 专用指标标不适用，通用事件与补数观测照常

probe_cases.summary_en: Isolate observation namespaces to prevent recursive probes and inflated business calls.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 观测事件再次进入被观测事件流
probe_cases.expected_zh: 命名空间隔离，避免递归触发和虚增业务调用

probe_cases.summary_en: Reject unexplained comparisons across incompatible metric/rule versions.
probe_cases.condition_zh: 聚合器与探针采用不同指标／规则版本
probe_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝无说明的直接比较，输出版本不兼容提示
